findings.description: The San Francisco Planning Commission voted Thursday, 24 September 2026, to grant Therapy Stores conditional-use authorization to open its 11th Bay Area location at 32 Clement Street, over Clement Street Merchants Association opposition planning to appeal. The page already carries the filing and hearing as mission-local-2026-09-24; this is the vote's outcome, not a repeat of that story.
